label: LoRA Showcase: Detail Portrait
description: Targets the flux1 family. A realism portrait that stacks three community LoRAs on the loras output — a base-realism model, the dedicated skin-texture model and an optional film look — while the prompt itself stays ordinary prose. Every LoRA slot is pinned to flux1, so the stack can never mix base families; anything missing from the loras folder downloads itself by its AIR urn.
prefix: A portrait made the way a working photographer makes one: a real person in front of real glass, held in shallow depth, every choice in the frame serving how the light lands on skin.
suffix: Finishing: (skin rendered as an actual surface rather than a smooth fill, carrying the faint asymmetry every real face has:1.2), individual hair strands separating where the key light catches them, (focus locked on the near eye:1.25). Colour kept honest and retouching held to what a good magazine would actually leave in.
negative: child, underage, deformed, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, caption overlay, plastic skin, oversmoothed skin, airbrushed doll face, lowres
